end.parentNote: Dev practised examples of traditional nature protection and explained ideas using cause-and-effect links. They clearly connected roots with holding soil and neem leaves with reducing insects in grain. One early answer about sacred groves was incomplete, but Dev later explained that plants and animals are protected there and that animals have food and shelter. At home, ask Dev to explain one example using “because” and draw a simple picture of it.
